mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mobile_access_code ( code, course_id, issued_by_user_id, created_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{code,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{courseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{issuedByUserId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
